title: Follow-up on the impact of germ cell-damaging therapies on fertility – A retrospective data analysis of the years 2013 to 2023 based on a patient cohort from the FertiTOX study conducted by the Department of Women's Health in Tübingen
summary: Many cancer treatments can lead to infertility, so there are options such as freezing eggs to preserve fertility. This study evaluates data from over 10 years to better understand which treatments affect fertility and to what extent, and which protective measures patients choose, so that future patients can be better advised.
conditions: fertility preservation counseling prior to gonadotoxic therapy

interventions.name: Patients who attended fertility preservation counseling prior to gonadotoxic therapy and agreed to participate in the FertiTOX study

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Presentation of patients in the Endocrinology and Reproductive Medicine Unit of the Department of Women's Health at the University Hospital of Tübingen (in the years 2013-2023) for consultation regarding fertility preservation
Exclusion criteria:
Missing relevant data
